purpose: Single source of truth for the Nabaperks NFC card registry, copy, and print pages. Cards are venue-branded: merchant name, stamps required, and the permanent join URL. Honest by contract — no free-stamp claims, no receipt claims, and first-stamp copy matches the OTP + terms join funnel.

product.kitSummary: Two two-sided NFC cards ready to print.

collection.name: NFC cards
collection.description: Reusable tap-and-scan cards for counters, tills and guest hand-out.

shared.reassurance: 18+ to redeem · One visit stamp here per UK date · Rewards redeem from the next weekday · Terms apply
shared.friction: One text · No app · In your browser
shared.claimFriction: No NFC? Scan the QR code

placeholders.stamps: Validated venue stampsRequired as a base-10 integer string.
placeholders.StampsWord: The same 1-6 stampsRequired value via shared.numberWords, first letter capitalised.

shared.placeholderPolicy: Resolve every customer-copy string before render; reject unknown or unresolved brace tokens.
shared.rolloutPolicy: Every registered NFC card renders on direct request and in the dev preview. Merchant surfaces expose production cards only.

qr.measurement: complete light box including quiet zone
qr.productionRule: Front QR encodes the venue share URL with src=qr. Program the NFC chip with the same path using src=nfc so analytics can distinguish tap from scan. Preserve square modules; proof tap and scan on representative phones.
